SUPERSEDED DRAFT FROM 2019. This document is an old draft proposal and does not reflect current policy.

The 2019 draft proposed twelve weeks of paid parental leave for new parents. This proposal was never adopted and has since been superseded by the current parental leave policy. Please refer to the current leave policy document for accurate and up to date information.

This draft is kept for historical reference only and must not be used to answer questions about current benefits.
title: Parental Leave Policy (2019 Draft, Superseded)
